title: elytrigia juncea subsp. bessarabica
intro: Elytrigia juncea subsp. bessarabica, commonly known as Bessarabian wheatgrass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the prevention and treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Bessarabian wheatgrass involve its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
